ValidationRule.description: Requires a reason for Closed / Lost Opportunities
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", ISPICKVAL (StageName, "Closed Lost"), ISBLANK (TEXT(Lost_Reason__c)), ISBLANK (TEXT( Lost_Sub_Reason__c )) ) && Opp_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A LOST REASON AND LOST SUB-REASON ARE REQUIRED
